prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact overall, but underestimated strong wins.
Home wait_info changes can be helpful (4 winning tests in rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 7 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in hint changes can be helpful (3 winning tests in rounds 4, 6, and 15), though 10 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in reorder and adoption new_flow changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
Choose_path layout, finish copy, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across agreeing tests.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, adoption hint, and single-test categories.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Overview Spotlight Screen: Adds a dedicated spotlight screen before home welcome explaining keyboard shortcuts and system tray controls. (why: Multiple support emails reported user confusion on how to control, hide, or bring back the pet after onboarding.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Account Pet History Hint: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen explaining that logging in restores previously saved pets and settings. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Story Scroll Stage: Redesigns the path selection screen into a vertical story-scroll layout highlighting setup time and pet options. (why: Choose path drops 20.4% of users and has a mean time of 514s; story scroll layout improves engagement.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Activity Progress Status Bar: Updates the render waiting screen with a status bar and live estimated remaining time indicator. (why: Home wait step has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s; progress updates keep users informed.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Custom Pet Photo Preview Flow: Inserts an interactive photo preview check screen allowing users to verify uploaded photos before generation. (why: Support received tickets regarding custom pet creation failing or looking wrong.)
5: [finish, copy] Taskbar and Pet Visibility Welcome Copy: Updates the home welcome text to explicitly state how to unhide the pet from the system tray. (why: Support tickets showed post-onboarding confusion regarding how to find or show hidden pets.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Rendering Guidance Hint: Adds a hint banner on the photo upload screen explaining photo quality standards for accurate rendering. (why: Addressing support issues with failed custom pet generations due to photo input quality.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Background Completion Notification: Enables desktop background notifications when pet generation completes while the app is minimized. (why: Long mean render wait time (2336s) causes users to leave without knowing setup finished.)

scores.note: Finish step loses 21.3% of users, but historical data shows finish new_screen changes average -0.7% across 7 tests.
Sign-in hints are low-cost text updates with proven positive history (+1.6% avg, 3 winning tests) backed by support emails.
Choose_path drops 20.4%, but choose_path redesigns historically perform poorly (-2.2% across 2 tests) and carry high dev cost.
Home wait_info changes consistently help (+1.0% avg across 11 tests, 4 winners) by addressing long render wait times.
Adoption step drops 33.8% of users, but adoption new_flow additions are consistently harmful (-5.5% avg across tests).
Config/copy change is cheap, but finish copy edits historically showed slight negative impact (-1.8%).
Targets the highest drop-off step (adoption, 33.8% drop) cheaply, but adoption hint evidence remains thin and slightly negative (-1.2%).
Addresses long render wait times (2336s mean), but home notification changes show no clear strong effect (+0.6% avg).
